note: head_sha is the two lane commits merged by git, made with a fixed identity and date so the same base and the same two gold patches always give the same sha. A pair git refuses has no head, and that is the measurement, not a gap.

cross_validation.note: The dataset's labels come from merging the gold patches; this manifest merges two lane commits on a fresh clone. Independent methods, the same 65 textual pairs that git will merge. The 505/499 difference is the six extra pairs the resolved census admits over the earlier 646, all of which conflict.
